# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 1: Espionage, Court Intrigue, Dynastic Diplomacy 2.0 & 6 Universal Cabinet Actions (oe_dip2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Release or Ransom Royal Hostage (礼送质子归国或索取赎金)
oe_dip2_ransom_or_release_hostage = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			oe_dip2_is_hostage_character = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_hostage
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_hostage_home }
					var:oe_dip2_hostage_home ?= { save_scope_as = oe_dip2_hostage_origin }
				}
			}
			scope:actor = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dip2.8
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

# 2. Commission Secret Court Whisperer (密敕宫廷暗桩监听朝堂)
oe_dip2_sponsor_court_whisperer = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 75
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_dip2_whisperer_cd_tt
				NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_dip2_whisperer_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			oe_dip2_eligible_whisperer_character = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -75
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_dip2_whisperer_cd years = 8 }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_whisper_network years = 8 mode = replace }
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_court_whisperer_char years = 8 mode = replace }
				save_scope_as = oe_dip2_whisperer_char
			}
			scope:actor = {
				random_list = {
					35 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_dip2.9 days = 15 } }
					65 = { }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -30
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 200
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_whisper_network }
				}
			}
			add = 40
		}
	}
}

# 3. Quietly Exile Court Rival Abroad (暗度陈仓：礼送政敌出境流亡)
oe_dip2_exile_court_rival = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			prestige >= 10
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_dip2_exile_rival_cd_tt
				NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_dip2_exile_rival_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			oe_dip2_eligible_exile_rival_character = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -10
				add_stability = 3
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_dip2_exile_rival_cd years = 5 }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_court_calm_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
				oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_neighbor_country = {
							country_exists = this
							is_rebel_country = no
							religion.group = scope:actor.religion.group
						}
					}
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							country_exists = this
							is_rebel_country = no
							religion.group = scope:actor.religion.group
						}
						save_scope_as = oe_dip2_exile_host
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_neighbor_country = {
							country_exists = this
							is_rebel_country = no
						}
					}
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							country_exists = this
							is_rebel_country = no
						}
						save_scope_as = oe_dip2_exile_host
					}
				}
				else = {
					random_country_in_diplomatic_range = {
						limit = {
							country_exists = this
							is_rebel_country = no
							NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						}
						save_scope_as = oe_dip2_exile_host
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_dip2_exile_host }
				scope:recipient = {
					move_country = scope:oe_dip2_exile_host
				}
				scope:oe_dip2_exile_host = {
					set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_harboring_claimant value = scope:actor years = 10 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}
